newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul boy in house with dead father for 10 days.
newsitem.headline: Seoul boy in house with dead father for 10 days.

text.p: A 12-year-old South Korean boy lived for 10 days with the body of his father in his home in Seoul for fear he would be sent to an orphanage, a police officer said on Sunday.
The boy, identified only by his family name Choi, had found his father lying dead at a room when he returned home on December 3, the officer said. He declined to give more details.
Yonhap quoted police investigators as saying they saw a long period of overdrinking as the cause of death of Choi's 42-year-old father, who was a casual labourer.
The man's death was discovered after Choi's landlord told police of a bad smell from inside Choi's home, Yonhap said.
The boy's mother died three years ago, police said.
